node.statement: The five actor points have y-coordinates y_v = 0, y_z = 0, y_o = 1, y_f = t, y_w = a*t, and since 0 < t = tau^2 < 1 and 0 < a = tau/(1+tau) < 1 all five lie in the interval [0,1]; by convexity of [0,1], every point of conv{p_v,p_w,p_f,p_z,p_o} has y-coordinate in [0,1]. Hence regime (i) implies regime (ii), the two regimes overlap rather than partition, and the parent statement's phrase 'exactly one of the two regimes' is incorrect as written: it must be read as 'at least one'.
